### Description
Attacks of moderate or severe, strictly unilateral head pain lasting seconds to minutes, occurring at least once daily. Trigeminal neuralgia caused by a multiple sclerosis (MS) plaque or plaques in the pons or trigeminal root entry zone, and associated with other symptoms and/or clinical or laboratory findings of MS.
